notes.title: Important changes in the demo
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

After continuing development on the project, I ran into an issue with some variables that ended up corrupting several save files. It was definitely a mistake on my part due to lack of programming experience. However, I'm working on it and taking steps to fix it. The first step was to cut the demo down to the beginning of Act Two instead of Act Three. I know that means removing almost an hour of content, but I can’t risk people losing their save files after trying it.

[img]https://images-wixmp-ed30a86b8c4ca887773594c2.wixmp.com/f/328c01ee-23a3-441d-a1f8-5ff3f5ab981d/dj90bf9-67ef05ae-4236-4829-a80b-081e4de83579.jpg/v1/fill/w_1192,h_670,q_70,strp/alright__let_s_be_friends__by_tharitley_dj90bf9-pre.jpg?token=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..kdnOQRVSzMOQD2HKUW_GE5w2ZSESWECTbNR-1Mik7_Y[/img]

[img]https://images-wixmp-ed30a86b8c4ca887773594c2.wixmp.com/f/328c01ee-23a3-441d-a1f8-5ff3f5ab981d/djh3xrj-b031f579-d21e-4e82-85e7-53658ece26d0.jpg/v1/fill/w_1192,h_670,q_70,strp/we_are_the_ones____by_tharitley_djh3xrj-pre.jpg?token=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..1mXD_3uQ3af9D7vVUHXdUr6dXvCwGHjRdlFcUIdexX0[/img]

On another note, I’m still working on a part of the story where the protagonist ends up inside a Western-themed video game. I’m about 3/4 done with that ending, and the next one will be where the player chooses to go find the suspect and resolve things directly.

Lastly, I’m starting a spinoff of the game called ShadowLess Light: The Gentleman, where I explore a different narrative and further develop characters from the main game. The biggest difference is that the spinoff isn’t an RPG, but a kinetic novel—and it includes a fair amount of erotic and adult content.

[img]https://images-wixmp-ed30a86b8c4ca887773594c2.wixmp.com/f/328c01ee-23a3-441d-a1f8-5ff3f5ab981d/djead83-b24e9f0c-c413-424c-86c0-6ff0c06690fb.jpg/v1/fill/w_1192,h_670,q_70,strp/shadowless_light__the_gentleman_by_tharitley_djead83-pre.jpg?token=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..WMxfToucQGuAQW_a8luQV3OR5rUl-l0Svo-yxdwoFEw[/img]

Anyway, I hope everything’s going great for all of you. Have a good week and see you next time!
